name: Juusha to Yukai na Nakama-tachi
original_name: 従者とゆかいな仲間たち
source:
A year after the battle of Ulnelis. 
The Lucius kingdom regains its peaceful days. But second prince Canaan-Lucius is not happy with current situation. He orders to send a message to the neighboring country Sanastia and sets off to pay it a visit.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
烏爾內利斯戰役結束一年後。
盧修斯王國恢復了和平的日子。然而，二王子迦南．盧修斯對現狀並不滿意。他命令向鄰國薩納斯蒂亞傳遞訊息，隨後啟程前往訪問。

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]］
